description: Minimal source dependency closure of official PEARL helpers, renamed for LRAEP.
transformations: Rename Python packages, classes, imports and local Rust package/module identifiers containing pearl to LRAEP.
Retain original copyright, license text, author attribution and source URLs.
Retain the original protocol serialization and cryptographic domain-separation bytes.
Expose __lraep_upstream_revision__ from the native module for provenance checks.
Omit unrelated node, wallet, UI, gateway service and external trainer applications.
